system_description.narrative_title: Repricing for Persistent Inflation: Bond Yields Surge and Rate-Hike Bets Rise
system_description.narrative_summary: Financial markets are undergoing a broad repricing as bond yields climb sharply on renewed fears that inflation is proving persistent and central banks — led by the Fed — will have to tighten policy further. The repricing is transmitting across markets and the real economy: higher Treasury yields and mortgage rates are pressuring housing activity, boosting the dollar, roiling sovereign bond markets in Europe, and reorienting investor demand for safe havens and credit. Feedback loops between inflation data, central-bank communications, and market positioning are amplifying volatility and feeding fiscal and macroeconomic stress points.
system_description.scope: Developed-market and major emerging-market sovereign bond markets, central-bank policy expectations (especially the Fed), inflation and price indices (PPI/CPI), interest-rate sensitive sectors (mortgages/housing), capital flows (FX/dollar), and core market instruments (Treasuries, sovereign bonds, gold).
system_description.super_system: Global financial system and the world macroeconomy (monetary policy, international capital flows, trade and commodity markets).
adjacent_subsystems: Fiscal policy and government debt issuance (deficits, Treasury auctions)
Corporate credit and equity markets (tech flows, corporate bonds, equity volatility)
Commodity and energy markets (oil, gold, import-driven inflation)
Household sector and real estate (mortgage rates, home sales, consumer spending)

variables.name: Aggregate inflation rate
variables.description: The broad, economy-wide rate of price change for consumption and production goods and services (e.g., CPI/PCE/PPI aggregates).

variables.name: Inflation breadth
variables.description: The share and dispersion of sectors and goods exhibiting rising prices, indicating how widespread inflationary pressure is across the economy.

variables.name: Long-term government bond yield
variables.description: The prevailing market yield on long-dated sovereign bonds, reflecting long-term real rates and term premium.

variables.name: Short-term policy interest rate
variables.description: The prevailing short-term policy interest rate level set in money markets that anchors overnight funding costs.

variables.name: Policy rate expectations
variables.description: Market participants' consensus view of the future path of short-term policy rates over defined horizons.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: The realized or implied short-term variability of asset prices across key markets (rates, equities, FX, commodities).

variables.name: Mortgage interest rate level
variables.description: The average effective interest rate charged on newly originated residential mortgages, reflecting longer-term yields and credit conditions.

variables.name: Housing transaction activity
variables.description: The flow of housing market transactions (sales/starts/permits) per period, indicating demand and supply turnover in real estate.

variables.name: Sovereign bond credit spread
variables.description: The yield premium demanded over a risk-free reference for a given sovereign issuer or group, reflecting perceived sovereign credit risk.

variables.name: Corporate credit spread
variables.description: The average yield premium on corporate bonds over comparable duration sovereign bonds, reflecting corporate credit risk and liquidity premia.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flow
variables.description: Net financial flows into or out of a market/region (portfolio, debt, and direct investment) measured over a period.

variables.name: Value of major currency index
variables.description: The effective exchange-rate level of a major currency basket, capturing its purchasing power and relative strength versus peers.

variables.name: Safe-asset demand
variables.description: The flow of investment demand for perceived safe-haven assets (sovereigns, gold, high-quality funding instruments) over a period.

variables.name: Monetary policy communication tone
variables.description: The prevailing tone and perceived hawkishness/dovishness in public communications and guidance about future monetary policy.

variables.name: Sovereign fiscal deficit
variables.description: The government budget shortfall measured as the net flow of borrowing requirement per period (revenues minus expenditures).

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: The ease with which assets can be transacted without large price impact, measured by bid-ask spreads, depth, and transaction costs.

catalysts.title: Continued Fed tightening bias
catalysts.description: Ongoing hawkish Fed rhetoric and balance-sheet/terminal-rate repricing that sustains upward pressure on rates and the dollar.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple Fed officials (Collins, Daly, Jefferson) signal more hikes; markets reprice rate-hike bets and yields surge.

catalysts.title: December FOMC meeting and decision
catalysts.description: Next scheduled Federal Open Market Committee meeting that could deliver a policy-rate change or signal further hikes.
catalysts.rationale: Rate-hike bets and hawkish Fed comments make the December meeting a likely market mover (bond yields, dollar).

catalysts.title: Next US monthly inflation release (CPI/PCE)
catalysts.description: Scheduled macro release(s) (CPI/PCE) that will update headline and breadth measures and likely drive market repricing.
catalysts.rationale: Wholesale/producer prices and commentary show inflation broadening; upcoming CPI/PCE prints will affect policy bets and yields.

catalysts.title: Elevated US Treasury issuance from large deficit
catalysts.description: Sustained high Treasury supply from a larger fiscal deficit that stresses demand and pushes yields and liquidity outcomes.
catalysts.rationale: US started 2027 with a record October deficit; softer 30-year auction demand signals issuance pressure on yields/liquidity.

catalysts.title: Widening eurozone sovereign bond divide
catalysts.description: Continued market differentiation across euro-area sovereigns (France, Belgium) that raises spreads and contagion risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France and Belgium fall foul of Eurozone bond market’s new divide'—higher spreads and cross-border flow shifts expected.

catalysts.title: Bank of England further rate-tightening risk
catalysts.description: BoE officials signalling more hikes could elevate UK short rates and influence global rate markets and mortgage costs.
catalysts.rationale: BoE chief economist says further rate rises needed, implying upcoming MPC tightening risk.

catalysts.title: Persisting housing-activity slowdown into spring
catalysts.description: High mortgage rates and record-low sales point to continued weak transaction flows through the upcoming spring selling season.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: existing/home sales at multi-year lows and mortgage rates soaring, undermining housing activity into spring.

catalysts.title: Dollar strength and safe-haven flow episodes
catalysts.description: Near-term episodes where hawkish Fed expectations drive dollar gains and shift flows into safe assets, pressuring gold and some bonds.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. dollar surges' and gold posts weekly losses as rate-hike bets and safe-haven flows intensify.
